Unforgettable coffee workshop

Amazing coffee workshop 
I went with 3 friends to a coffee workshop in Hoi An and we left smiling from end to end.
Beyond the price, which was not expensive, we enjoyed the experience. 
The host, Toan, was very patient, caring, funny, and professional. 
In the background, there was music from the 2000s that really added to the atmosphere. 
They told us before the workshop that it takes an hour.
We stayed twice as long for the same price and enjoyed every moment.
Highly recommend
